description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute' which is a part of the HTMLPurifier library. Its purpose is to process URIs and convert relative URIs to absolute URIs based on a base URI, including handling of various path and scheme scenarios.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A class for converting relative URIs to absolute URIs within the HTML Purifier filtering process. It handles various URI scenarios and ensures proper normalization of URI paths.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration, setting the base URI and preparing a path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Converts relative URIs to absolute ones based on the base URI, handling various edge cases and path normalization.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Resolves dots and double-dots in URI path segments for proper path normalization.
